profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
After working as a software engineer for years, I still never get tired of learning new things and solving new kinds of problems. My experience includes backend work in Java, Ruby on Rails, Python, Kotlin, and TypeScript, but I consider myself language agnostic. In the end it's more about finding the right tool for the task at hand!

I'm based in Fort Collins, Colorado and in my free time I enjoy crocheting, playing the cello, and hanging out with my cats. Message me if you'd like to connect!

positions.title: Senior Platform Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, built, and maintained internal tools and services to streamline the development workflow and enhance the productivity of Alma’s engineering teams.
• Improved developer efficiency and system reliability by leading software upgrades, stabilizing data sanitation processes, and leading the successful proof of concept for privacy-safe testing data using Tonic.ai.
• Tech stack: Asana, AWS, Datadog, Django, Docker, Github Actions, Guru, JavaScript, LaunchDarkly, MySQL, Python, React, and Redis.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Datadog · Django · Docker · Github · Guru · JavaScript · MySQL · Python (Programming Language) · React.js

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Conceptualized and built features in microservices as part of a large-scale distributed system using Python, TypeScript, and Node.
• Created data models using a MySQL database and designed and implemented API methods to use them.
• Triaged and resolved production issues as part of an on call rotation, owning team features and systems and jumping in to help other teams as needed.
• Designed platform infrastructure to be performant, reliable, and maintainable. Contributed to engineering standards, tooling, and processes.
• Met with stakeholders across functional teams to maintain communication around projects and initiatives.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Node.js · Python (Programming Language) · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · GraphQL

positions.title: Senior Platform Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed, tested, and deployed microservices and APIs in Ruby on Rails, Java, and Python with a focus on scalability and reliability.
• Provided mentorship to junior engineers, interviewed and onboarded new hires, and deeply reviewed code.
• Leveraged AWS tools such as API Gateway, Cloudwatch, DDB, EC2, ECR, EKS, IAM, Kinesis, Lambda, S3, SNS, Step Functions, and VPC.
• Researched new tools and technologies and led teach-outs for the engineering team at large.
• Led several cross-functional projects, scoped roadmaps, led technical architecture discussions, and met with stakeholders.

positions.title: Platform Engineer
positions.description:
• Built, deployed, and tested microservices in Java, Kotlin, Ruby on Rails, and Python.
• Leveraged AWS tools such as EC2, S3, SNS, SQS, IAM, Kinesis, Lambda, DynamoDB, Step Functions, and Cloudwatch.
• Authored technical documentation within code repositories and on Confluence, creating additional visual aids in Miro and Lucidchart.
• Designed, optimized, and implemented large scale databases with millions of rows in both SQS and NoSQL contexts.
• Contributed to a cross-functional team including mobile, product, design, data, and security experts.

positions.title: Back End Developer
positions.description:
• Developed, tested, and shipped full stack applications at a blockchain-focused agency using TypeScript, Kotlin, and React.
• Built React frontends to consume and analyze Ethereum blockchain data, translating UI/UX requirements as a full stack engineer.
• Performed data validation using several different types of hashing.
• Researched emerging libraries and technologies and presented findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
• Worked on a cross-functional team in a scrum environment leveraging Jira.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Design · Software Architectural Design · React.js · JavaScript · TypeScript · Kotlin · Jira · Bitcoin · Ethereum · Smart Contracts · Cryptography

positions.title: Licensed Substitute Teacher
positions.description:

• Followed lesson plans

•  Monitored student understanding and accuracy of classwork
• Graded papers
• Kept notes for regular teacher
• Set up interactive electronic equipment
• Performed troubleshooting when technology issues arose

projects.title: sipster
projects.description: With ample opportunities for free drinks in the tech community, it can be easy to lose track of just how much alcohol you're consuming. Sipster tracks your daily intake and allows you to set goals for your health.

projects.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stomach
projects.description: Explore quotes about Harry Potter's stomach from all seven Harry Potter books, and even add your own! Built using Ember, Knex.js, Stripe, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Express.
